objective: Sanitized attributable progress during work and cinematic operation evidence; no private model chain of thought
safety_rules: Only the existing Ed25519-trusted signer can attest progress

A signed progress record does not grant tool execution, posting, device control, or trading
Existing owner STOP and Hermes voice STOP remain in place
remaining_gates: Server-side enrolled signer and event producer with durable receipt store
Read-only owner-preemptible event transport via tested OAuth scope
End-to-end received frame validation in original 8x8 Observatory
Private plugin package upgrade with rollback and reviewed assets
Actual browser and signed Android app acceptance independently verified
